assessment: The SNX-BAR family of sorting nexins are a diverse group of dimeric proteins that form tubules from endosomal membranes where they also select protein cargoes for incorporation into these transport carriers. Here the authors describe a new SNX-BAR complex in budding yeast, named the VINE complex, that uniquely harbors a guanine nucleotide exchange factor (GEF) domain for Rab5-related small GTP-binding proteins. The authors' highly compelling data implicate VINE in endosomal membrane remodeling events and the sorting of a vacuolar hydrolase receptor and will be of broad interest to scientists studying membrane trafficking and receptor recycling.
